$$

The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int (2{x}^{7}-\frac{1}{8|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}})\text{d}x & =\int 2{x}^{7}\,\text{d}x-\int \frac{1}{8|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =2\int {x}^{7}\,\text{d}x+\frac{1}{8}\int -\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}+1}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4}{x}^{8}+\frac{1}{8}\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x+C \\  & =\frac{1}{4}({x}^{8}+\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)+C\end{aligned}
$$
